verses.original: וַיּוֹלִכֵ֖נִי אֶל־ הַשָּׁ֑עַר שַׁ֕עַר אֲשֶׁ֥ר פֹּנֶ֖ה דֶּ֥רֶךְ הַקָּדִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·w·li·ḵê·nî ’el- haš·šā·‘ar ša·‘ar ’ă·šer pō·neh de·reḵ haq·qā·ḏîm
verses.literal: Then the man brought me back to the gate that faces . . . east

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֗ה כְּבוֹד֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בָּ֖א מִדֶּ֣רֶךְ הַקָּדִ֑ים וְקוֹל֗וֹ כְּקוֹל֙ מַ֣יִם רַבִּ֔ים וְהָאָ֖רֶץ הֵאִ֥ירָה מִכְּבֹדֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh kə·ḇō·wḏ ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl bā mid·de·reḵ haq·qā·ḏîm wə·qō·w·lōw kə·qō·wl ma·yim rab·bîm wə·hā·’ā·reṣ hê·’î·rāh mik·kə·ḇō·ḏōw
verses.literal: and I saw the glory of the God of Israel coming from the east His voice was like the roar of many waters and the earth shone with His glory

verses.original: וּכְמַרְאֵ֨ה הַמַּרְאֶ֜ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר רָאִ֗יתִי כַּמַּרְאֶ֤ה אֲשֶׁר־ רָאִ֙יתִי֙ בְּבֹאִי֙ לְשַׁחֵ֣ת אֶת־ הָעִ֔יר וּמַרְא֕וֹת כַּמַּרְאֶ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר רָאִ֖יתִי אֶל־ נְהַר־ כְּבָ֑ר וָאֶפֹּ֖ל אֶל־ פָּנָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḵə·mar·’êh ham·mar·’eh ’ă·šer rā·’î·ṯî kam·mar·’eh ’ă·šer- rā·’î·ṯî bə·ḇō·’î lə·ša·ḥêṯ ’eṯ- hā·‘îr ū·mar·’ō·wṯ kam·mar·’eh ’ă·šer rā·’î·ṯî ’el- nə·har- kə·ḇār wā·’ep·pōl ’el- pā·nāy
verses.literal: The vision I saw was like the vision - I had seen when He came to destroy the city and like the visions I had seen by the River Kebar I fell facedown . . .

verses.original: וּכְב֥וֹד יְהוָ֖ה בָּ֣א אֶל־ הַבָּ֑יִת דֶּ֣רֶךְ שַׁ֔עַר אֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּנָ֖יו דֶּ֥רֶךְ הַקָּדִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḵə·ḇō·wḏ Yah·weh bā ’el- hab·bā·yiṯ de·reḵ ša·‘ar ’ă·šer pā·nāw de·reḵ haq·qā·ḏîm
verses.literal: and the glory of the LORD entered . . . the temple through the gate facing . . . east

verses.original: וַתִּשָּׂאֵ֣נִי ר֔וּחַ וַתְּבִיאֵ֕נִי אֶל־ הֶֽחָצֵ֖ר הַפְּנִימִ֑י וְהִנֵּ֛ה מָלֵ֥א כְבוֹד־ יְהוָ֖ה הַבָּֽיִת׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiś·śā·’ê·nî rū·aḥ wat·tə·ḇî·’ê·nî ’el- he·ḥā·ṣêr hap·pə·nî·mî wə·hin·nêh mā·lê ḵə·ḇō·wḏ- Yah·weh hab·bā·yiṯ
verses.literal: Then the Spirit lifted me up and brought me into the inner . . . court and the glory of the LORD filled the temple

verses.original: וָאֶשְׁמַ֛ע מִדַּבֵּ֥ר אֵלַ֖י מֵהַבָּ֑יִת וְאִ֕ישׁ הָיָ֥ה עֹמֵ֖ד אֶצְלִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eš·ma‘ mid·dab·bêr ’ê·lay mê·hab·bā·yiṯ wə·’îš hā·yāh ‘ō·mêḏ ’eṣ·lî
verses.literal: While the man was standing beside me I heard someone speaking to me from inside the temple

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗י בֶּן־ אָדָם֙ אֶת־ מְק֣וֹם כִּסְאִ֗י וְאֶת־ מְקוֹם֙ כַּפּ֣וֹת רַגְלַ֔י אֲשֶׁ֧ר אֶשְׁכָּן־ שָׁ֛ם בְּת֥וֹךְ בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְעוֹלָ֑ם וְלֹ֣א יְטַמְּא֣וּ ע֣וֹד בֵּֽית־ יִ֠שְׂרָאֵל שֵׁ֣ם קָדְשִׁ֞י הֵ֤מָּה וּמַלְכֵיהֶם֙ בִּזְנוּתָ֔ם וּבְפִגְרֵ֥י מַלְכֵיהֶ֖ם בָּמוֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lay ben- ’ā·ḏām ’eṯ- mə·qō·wm kis·’î wə·’eṯ- mə·qō·wm kap·pō·wṯ raḡ·lay ’ă·šer ’eš·kān- šām bə·ṯō·wḵ bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl lə·‘ō·w·lām wə·lō yə·ṭam·mə·’ū ‘ō·wḏ bêṯ- yiś·rā·’êl šêm qāḏ·šî hêm·māh ū·mal·ḵê·hem biz·nū·ṯām ū·ḇə·p̄iḡ·rê mal·ḵê·hem bā·mō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: and He said to me Son of man this is the place of My throne and the place for the soles of My feet where I will dwell . . . among the Israelites forever . . . The house of Israel will never again defile My holy name neither they nor their kings by their prostitution and by the funeral offerings for their kings at their deaths

verses.original: בְּתִתָּ֨ם סִפָּ֜ם אֶת־ סִפִּ֗י וּמְזֽוּזָתָם֙ אֵ֣צֶל מְזוּזָתִ֔י וְהַקִּ֖יר בֵּינִ֣י וּבֵֽינֵיהֶ֑ם וְטִמְּא֣וּ׀ אֶת־ שֵׁ֣ם קָדְשִׁ֗י בְּתֽוֹעֲבוֹתָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשׂ֔וּ וָאֲכַ֥ל אֹתָ֖ם בְּאַפִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ṯit·tām sip·pām ’eṯ- sip·pî ū·mə·zū·zā·ṯām ’ê·ṣel mə·zū·zā·ṯî wə·haq·qîr bê·nî ū·ḇê·nê·hem wə·ṭim·mə·’ū ’eṯ- šêm qāḏ·šî bə·ṯō·w·‘ă·ḇō·w·ṯām ’ă·šer ‘ā·śū wā·’ă·ḵal ’ō·ṯām bə·’ap·pî
verses.literal: When they placed their threshold next to My threshold and their doorposts beside My doorposts with only a wall between Me and them . . . they defiled My holy name by the abominations they committed Therefore I have consumed them in My anger

verses.original: עַתָּ֞ה יְרַחֲק֧וּ אֶת־ זְנוּתָ֛ם וּפִגְרֵ֥י מַלְכֵיהֶ֖ם מִמֶּ֑נִּי וְשָׁכַנְתִּ֥י בְתוֹכָ֖ם לְעוֹלָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘at·tāh yə·ra·ḥă·qū ’eṯ- zə·nū·ṯām ū·p̄iḡ·rê mal·ḵê·hem mim·men·nî wə·šā·ḵan·tî ḇə·ṯō·w·ḵām lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: Now let them remove far from Me their prostitution and the funeral offerings for their kings and I will dwell among them forever

verses.original: אַתָּ֣ה בֶן־ אָדָ֗ם הַגֵּ֤ד אֶת־ בֵּֽית־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶת־ הַבַּ֔יִת וְיִכָּלְמ֖וּ מֵעֲוֺנֽוֹתֵיהֶ֑ם וּמָדְד֖וּ אֶת־ תָּכְנִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: ’at·tāh ḇen- ’ā·ḏām hag·gêḏ ’eṯ- bêṯ- yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- hab·ba·yiṯ wə·yik·kā·lə·mū mê·‘ă·wō·nō·w·ṯê·hem ū·mā·ḏə·ḏū ’eṯ- tā·ḵə·nîṯ
verses.literal: As for you son of man describe the temple to the people of Israel so that they may be ashamed of their iniquities Let them measure the plan

verses.original: וְאִֽם־ נִכְלְמ֞וּ מִכֹּ֣ל אֲשֶׁר־ עָשׂ֗וּ צוּרַ֣ת הַבַּ֡יִת וּתְכוּנָת֡וֹ וּמוֹצָאָ֡יו וּמוֹבָאָ֣יו וְֽכָל־ צֽוּרֹתָ֡ו וְאֵ֣ת כָּל־ חֻקֹּתָיו֩ וְכָל־ צוּרֹתָי וְכָל־ תּוֹרֹתוֹ הוֹדַ֣ע אוֹתָ֔ם וּכְתֹ֖ב לְעֵֽינֵיהֶ֑ם וְיִשְׁמְר֞וּ אֶת־ כָּל־ צוּרָת֛וֹ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ חֻקֹּתָ֖יו וְעָשׂ֥וּ אוֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- niḵ·lə·mū mik·kōl ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śū ṣū·raṯ hab·ba·yiṯ ū·ṯə·ḵū·nā·ṯōw ū·mō·w·ṣā·’āw ū·mō·w·ḇā·’āw wə·ḵāl ṣū·rō·ṯå̄w wə·’êṯ kāl- ḥuq·qō·ṯāw wə·ḵāl ṣū·rō·ṯå̄y wə·ḵāl tō·rō·ṯō hō·w·ḏa‘ ’ō·w·ṯām ū·ḵə·ṯōḇ lə·‘ê·nê·hem wə·yiš·mə·rū ’eṯ- kāl- ṣū·rā·ṯōw wə·’eṯ- kāl- ḥuq·qō·ṯāw wə·‘ā·śū ’ō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: and if they are ashamed of all they have done then make known to them the design of the temple its arrangement and its exits and entrances its whole design along with all its statutes forms and laws Write it down in their sight so that they may keep its complete design and all its statutes and may carry them out

verses.original: זֹ֖את תּוֹרַ֣ת הַבָּ֑יִת עַל־ רֹ֣אשׁ הָ֠הָר כָּל־ גְּבֻל֞וֹ סָבִ֤יב׀ סָבִיב֙ קֹ֣דֶשׁ קָדָשִׁ֔ים הִנֵּה־ זֹ֖את תּוֹרַ֥ת הַבָּֽיִת׃
verses.transliteration: zōṯ tō·w·raṯ hab·bā·yiṯ ‘al- rōš hā·hār kāl- gə·ḇu·lōw sā·ḇîḇ sā·ḇîḇ qō·ḏeš qā·ḏā·šîm hin·nêh- zōṯ tō·w·raṯ hab·bā·yiṯ
verses.literal: This is the law of the temple All its surrounding . . . territory on top of the mountain will be most holy . . . Yes this is the law of the temple

verses.original: וְאֵ֨לֶּה מִדּ֤וֹת הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ בָּֽאַמּ֔וֹת אַמָּ֥ה אַמָּ֖ה וָטֹ֑פַח וְחֵ֨יק הָאַמָּ֜ה וְאַמָּה־ רֹ֗חַב וּגְבוּלָ֨הּ אֶל־ שְׂפָתָ֤הּ סָבִיב֙ זֶ֣רֶת הָאֶחָ֔ד וְזֶ֖ה גַּ֥ב הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh mid·dō·wṯ ham·miz·bê·aḥ bā·’am·mō·wṯ ’am·māh ’am·māh wā·ṭō·p̄aḥ wə·ḥêq hā·’am·māh wə·’am·māh- rō·ḥaḇ ū·ḡə·ḇū·lāh ’el- śə·p̄ā·ṯāh sā·ḇîḇ ze·reṯ hā·’e·ḥāḏ wə·zeh gaḇ ham·miz·bê·aḥ
verses.literal: These are the measurements of the altar in long cubits a cubit . . . and a handbreadth Its gutter shall be a cubit deep and a cubit wide with a rim . . . of one span around its edge And this is the height of the altar

verses.original: וּמֵחֵ֨יק הָאָ֜רֶץ עַד־ הָעֲזָרָ֤ה הַתַּחְתּוֹנָה֙ שְׁתַּ֣יִם אַמּ֔וֹת וְרֹ֖חַב אַמָּ֣ה אֶחָ֑ת וּמֵהֳעֲזָרָ֨ה הַקְּטַנָּ֜ה עַד־ הָעֲזָרָ֤ה הַגְּדוֹלָה֙ אַרְבַּ֣ע אַמּ֔וֹת וְרֹ֖חַב הָאַמָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mê·ḥêq hā·’ā·reṣ ‘aḏ- hā·‘ă·zā·rāh hat·taḥ·tō·w·nāh šə·ta·yim ’am·mō·wṯ wə·rō·ḥaḇ ’am·māh ’e·ḥāṯ ū·mê·ho·‘ă·zā·rāh haq·qə·ṭan·nāh ‘aḏ- hā·‘ă·zā·rāh hag·gə·ḏō·w·lāh ’ar·ba‘ ’am·mō·wṯ wə·rō·ḥaḇ hā·’am·māh
verses.literal: The space from the gutter on the ground to the lower ledge shall be two cubits and the ledge one cubit wide The space from the smaller ledge to the larger ledge shall be four cubits and the ledge one cubit wide

verses.original: וְהַֽהַרְאֵ֖ל אַרְבַּ֣ע אַמּ֑וֹת וּמֵהָאֲרִאֵ֣יל וּלְמַ֔עְלָה הַקְּרָנ֖וֹת אַרְבַּֽע׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ha·har·’êl ’ar·ba‘ ’am·mō·wṯ ū·mē·hå̄·ʾă·ri·ʾēl ū·lə·ma‘·lāh haq·qə·rā·nō·wṯ ’ar·ba‘
verses.literal: The altar hearth shall be four cubits high and four horns shall project upward from the hearth

verses.original: וְהָאֲרִאֵיל שְׁתֵּ֤ים עֶשְׂרֵה֙ אֹ֔רֶךְ בִּשְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה רֹ֑חַב רָב֕וּעַ אֶ֖ל אַרְבַּ֥עַת רְבָעָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hå̄·ʾă·ri·ʾēl šə·têm ‘eś·rêh ’ō·reḵ biš·têm ‘eś·rêh rō·ḥaḇ rā·ḇū·a‘ ’el ’ar·ba·‘aṯ rə·ḇā·‘āw
verses.literal: The altar hearth shall be square at its four corners twelve cubits . . . long and twelve cubits . . . wide

verses.original: וְהָעֲזָרָ֞ה אַרְבַּ֧ע עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה אֹ֗רֶךְ בְּאַרְבַּ֤ע עֶשְׂרֵה֙ רֹ֔חַב אֶ֖ל אַרְבַּ֣עַת רְבָעֶ֑יהָ וְהַגְּבוּל סָבִ֨יב אוֹתָ֜הּ חֲצִ֣י הָאַמָּ֗ה וְהַֽחֵיק־ לָ֤הּ אַמָּה֙ סָבִ֔יב וּמַעֲלֹתֵ֖הוּ פְּנ֥וֹת קָדִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·‘ă·zā·rāh ’ar·ba‘ ‘eś·rêh ’ō·reḵ bə·’ar·ba‘ ‘eś·rêh rō·ḥaḇ ’el ’ar·ba·‘aṯ rə·ḇā·‘e·hā wə·hag·gə·ḇūl sā·ḇîḇ ’ō·w·ṯāh ḥă·ṣî hā·’am·māh wə·ha·ḥêq- lāh ’am·māh sā·ḇîḇ ū·ma·‘ă·lō·ṯê·hū pə·nō·wṯ qā·ḏîm
verses.literal: The ledge shall also be square . . . . . . fourteen cubits . . . long and fourteen cubits . . . wide with a rim of half a cubit and a gutter of a cubit all around it The steps of the altar shall face east

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗י בֶּן־ אָדָם֙ כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה אֵ֚לֶּה חֻקּ֣וֹת הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ בְּי֖וֹם הֵעָֽשׂוֹת֑וֹ לְהַעֲל֤וֹת עָלָיו֙ עוֹלָ֔ה וְלִזְרֹ֥ק עָלָ֖יו דָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lay ben- ’ā·ḏām kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’êl·leh ḥuq·qō·wṯ ham·miz·bê·aḥ bə·yō·wm hê·‘ā·śō·w·ṯōw lə·ha·‘ă·lō·wṯ ‘ā·lāw ‘ō·w·lāh wə·liz·rōq ‘ā·lāw dām
verses.literal: Then He said to me Son of man this is what the Lord GOD says These are the statutes for the altar on the day it is constructed so that burnt offerings may be sacrificed on it and blood may be splattered on it

verses.original: וְנָתַתָּ֣ה אֶל־ הַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים הַלְוִיִּ֡ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֵם֩ מִזֶּ֨רַע צָד֜וֹק הַקְּרֹבִ֣ים אֵלַ֗י נְאֻ֛ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִ֖ה לְשָֽׁרְתֵ֑נִי פַּ֥ר בֶּן־ בָּקָ֖ר לְחַטָּֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tāh ’el- hak·kō·hă·nîm hal·wî·yim ’ă·šer hêm miz·ze·ra‘ ṣā·ḏō·wq haq·qə·rō·ḇîm ’ê·lay nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh lə·šā·rə·ṯê·nî par ben- bā·qār lə·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ
verses.literal: You are to give a young bull from the herd as a sin offering to the Levitical priests who are of the family of Zadok who approach Me to minister before Me declares the Lord GOD

verses.original: וְלָקַחְתָּ֣ מִדָּמ֗וֹ וְנָ֨תַתָּ֜ה עַל־ אַרְבַּ֤ע קַרְנֹתָיו֙ וְאֶל־ אַרְבַּע֙ פִּנּ֣וֹת הָעֲזָרָ֔ה וְאֶֽל־ הַגְּב֖וּל סָבִ֑יב וְחִטֵּאתָ֥ אוֹת֖וֹ וְכִפַּרְתָּֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·qaḥ·tā mid·dā·mōw wə·nā·ṯat·tāh ‘al- ’ar·ba‘ qar·nō·ṯāw wə·’el- ’ar·ba‘ pin·nō·wṯ hā·‘ă·zā·rāh wə·’el- hag·gə·ḇūl sā·ḇîḇ wə·ḥiṭ·ṭê·ṯā ’ō·w·ṯōw wə·ḵip·par·tā·hū
verses.literal: You are to take some of its blood and put it on the four horns of the altar on the four corners of the ledge . . . and all around the rim thus you will cleanse the altar and make atonement for it

verses.original: וְלָ֣קַחְתָּ֔ אֵ֖ת הַפָּ֣ר הַֽחַטָּ֑את וּשְׂרָפוֹ֙ בְּמִפְקַ֣ד הַבַּ֔יִת מִח֖וּץ לַמִּקְדָּֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·qaḥ·tā ’êṯ hap·pār ha·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ ū·śə·rā·p̄ōw bə·mip̄·qaḏ hab·ba·yiṯ mi·ḥūṣ lam·miq·dāš
verses.literal: Then you are to take away the bull for the sin offering and burn it in the appointed part of the temple area outside the sanctuary

verses.original: וּבַיּוֹם֙ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י תַּקְרִ֛יב שְׂעִיר־ עִזִּ֥ים תָּמִ֖ים לְחַטָּ֑את וְחִטְּאוּ֙ אֶת־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר חִטְּא֖וּ בַּפָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇay·yō·wm haš·šê·nî taq·rîḇ śə·‘îr- ‘iz·zîm tā·mîm lə·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ wə·ḥiṭ·ṭə·’ū ’eṯ- ham·miz·bê·aḥ ka·’ă·šer ḥiṭ·ṭə·’ū bap·pār
verses.literal: On the second day you are to present an unblemished male goat . . . as a sin offering and the altar is to be cleansed as it was . . . with the bull

verses.original: בְּכַלּוֹתְךָ֖ מֵֽחַטֵּ֑א תַּקְרִיב֙ פַּ֣ר בֶּן־ בָּקָ֣ר תָּמִ֔ים וְאַ֥יִל מִן־ הַצֹּ֖אן תָּמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḵal·lō·wṯ·ḵā mê·ḥaṭ·ṭê taq·rîḇ par ben- bā·qār tā·mîm wə·’a·yil min- haṣ·ṣōn tā·mîm
verses.literal: When you have finished the purification you are to present a young . . . unblemished bull and an unblemished ram from the flock

verses.original: וְהִקְרַבְתָּ֖ם לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְהִשְׁלִ֨יכוּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֤ים עֲלֵיהֶם֙ מֶ֔לַח וְהֶעֱל֥וּ אוֹתָ֛ם עֹלָ֖ה לַֽיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiq·raḇ·tām lip̄·nê Yah·weh wə·hiš·lî·ḵū hak·kō·hă·nîm ‘ă·lê·hem me·laḥ wə·he·‘ĕ·lū ’ō·w·ṯām ‘ō·lāh Yah·weh
verses.literal: You must present them before the LORD the priests are to sprinkle salt on them and sacrifice them as a burnt offering to the LORD

verses.original: שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה שְׂעִיר־ חַטָּ֖את לַיּ֑וֹם וּפַ֧ר בֶּן־ בָּקָ֛ר וְאַ֥יִל מִן־ הַצֹּ֖אן תְּמִימִ֥ים יַעֲשֽׂוּ׃
verses.transliteration: šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm ta·‘ă·śeh śə·‘îr- ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ lay·yō·wm ū·p̄ar ben- bā·qār wə·’a·yil min- haṣ·ṣōn tə·mî·mîm ya·‘ă·śū
verses.literal: For seven days you are to provide a male goat daily for a sin offering you are also to provide a young bull . . . . . . and a ram from the flock both unblemished

verses.original: שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֗ים יְכַפְּרוּ֙ אֶת־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וְטִֽהֲר֖וּ אֹת֑וֹ וּמִלְא֖וּ יָדוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm yə·ḵap·pə·rū ’eṯ- ham·miz·bê·aḥ wə·ṭi·hă·rū ’ō·ṯōw ū·mil·’ū yå̄·ḏō
verses.literal: For seven days the priests are to make atonement for the altar and cleanse it so they shall consecrate it

verses.original: וִֽיכַלּ֖וּ אֶת־ הַיָּמִ֑יםס וְהָיָה֩ בַיּ֨וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִ֜י וָהָ֗לְאָה יַעֲשׂ֨וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֤ים עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ אֶת־ עוֹלֽוֹתֵיכֶם֙ וְאֶת־ שַׁלְמֵיכֶ֔ם וְרָצִ֣אתִי אֶתְכֶ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהֹוִֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wî·ḵal·lū ’eṯ- hay·yå̄·mī·ms wə·hā·yāh ḇay·yō·wm haš·šə·mî·nî wā·hā·lə·’āh ya·‘ă·śū hak·kō·hă·nîm ‘al- ham·miz·bê·aḥ ’eṯ- ‘ō·w·lō·w·ṯê·ḵem wə·’eṯ- šal·mê·ḵem wə·rā·ṣi·ṯî ’eṯ·ḵem nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: At the end of these days . . . from the eighth day on the priests are to present your burnt offerings and peace offerings on the altar Then I will accept you declares the Lord GOD
